## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* sectional analysis (*kē* 科) by **Yùgāng Méngrùn** 玉岡蒙潤 (1276–1343) on the Yuán-period combined edition of Dìguān's *Tiāntái sìjiào yí* ([KR6d0168](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0168), T1931) with its principal Sòng-Yuán commentaries (the *Sìjiào yí jízhù*). The work belongs to the standard Yuán-period editorial pattern of pairing major commentarial works with their structural-outline navigational apparatus.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Méngrùn's productive period c. 1300–1343.
